params.prompt: Ultra-realistic cinematic photo, square frame, night. A huge dim open-plan office at eye level: in the foreground and on the left, rows of abandoned empty office chairs and dark switched-off monitors, a forgotten coffee mug, dust in the air; deeper on the right a few desks still glow warm gold where small sleek black-and-gold robot assistants keep working at keyboards. The upper 50% of the frame is dark ceiling and shadow, empty for a headline. No people. Moody chiaroscuro, deep blacks, warm golden light, film grain. No text, no letters, no logos, no blue, no green.
